source.stem:
Multiple choice question: Which of the following statements about gymnosperms and angiosperms is correct ( )
A. The seeds of gymnosperms are covered with pericarp.
B. The seeds of angiosperms are exposed
C. Gymnosperm seeds are exposed
D. The cones of gymnosperms are fruits

options.text: The seeds of gymnosperms are covered by a pericarp
The seeds of angiosperms are exposed
The cones of gymnosperms are fruits

mx.teacher_note: Water and minerals move from roots to leaves through phloem.

mx.name: relationship_reversal

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: Xylem carries water and minerals to leaves only, not to flowers.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: A naturally red flower proves water has travelled up its stem.

intelligence.enrichment: Roots take up water along with minerals from the soil, and xylem transports them to leaves and other parts of the plant. Root uptake of water and minerals -> upward transport through xylem -> arrival at leaves, stems, and flowers. The learner correctly applies this rule: Roots take up water along with minerals from the soil, and xylem transports them to leaves and other parts of the plant. Water spreads through any visible part of a plant, so named tubes and upward direction do not matter.
